skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and principles of sustainable development in the context of globalization, international integration, and climate change.
Analyze the economic development of Vietnam from a sustainable development perspective, identifying unsustainable factors and their causes.
Propose policy directions and solutions for sustainable economic development in Vietnam.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate sustainable development issues and engage in constructive debates.
Apply data analysis techniques to assess the sustainability of Vietnam's economic development.
Work effectively in groups, leading and coordinating activities to achieve sustainable development goals.
Improve communication skills through presentations, discussions, and written assignments.
Understand and apply ethical principles in sustainable development practices.
